title: The Board desk keeps a 268px packet rail beside a 122px desk at phone width
body:
## Summary
BoardDesk's grid has no phone breakpoint: at 390px the packet rail keeps var(--w-packet-rail) (268px) and the desk gets what is left.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/desk/Desk.module.css:4 `.board{grid-template-columns:var(--w-packet-rail) minmax(0,1fr)}` with no @media; the part workspace beside it stacks its regions at max-width 900px (packages/ui/src/components/part/Part.module.css:60-71). On a phone the cull desk, the blind pair and the commit button share 390-268 = 122px less padding. Fixed looks like the workspace's own rule: one column under 900px, the rail a bounded strip above the desk (or behind the Floor's own back link).

## Flow
- open /board/<packet> at 390px width -> the rail takes 69% of the width
- fix: @media (max-width:900px) stack .board, cap .rail height, border-bottom instead of border-right
- capture board and board-sheet at --width 390 before and after

## Expected impact
The operator triaging a morning packet from a phone sees the tiles instead of a rail. Could break: the sheet variant's height arithmetic.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the desk is usable at phone width
Before: desk width 122px at 390 (arithmetic over Desk.module.css:4 and tokens.ts w-packet-rail 268px)
After: ~358px predicted (390 - 2x16 gutter)
Method: simulation - the figure is CSS arithmetic; no dev server or capture is allowed in this round, and a layout change lands only photographed
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: CX_BASE=... node pipeline/cx-capture.mjs board out.png --width 390 (and board-sheet), desk width measured before/after; tests/live/legibility.live.spec.ts at 390

title: A desk picture that fails to load draws the browser's broken-image glyph
body: ## Summary Plate, the one the desks draw (13 call sites), has no load-failure state. ## Description packages/ui/src/components/desk/Plate.tsx:9 renders a bare with no onError; CullTile, VariantCard, RunCard, RunModal, BlindPair and ScheduleForm all draw through it. A candidate whose blob 404s or fails to decode is drawn as the browser's broken-image icon plus alt text, indistinguishable at a glance from a dark candidate in a grid, and the operator can keep or reject a picture nobody saw. The media editors already answer this (part-editor-media-cut-score: 'A kept still that does not load says so'). Fixed: Plate tracks load failure and draws a hatched ground with an accessible 'not loaded' name, the kit's existing absent-plate shape (FrameCanvas .ground). ## Flow - a packet whose candidate url 404s -> the tile shows a broken-image glyph - fix: Plate becomes a client component with an error state; failed -> the hatched ground + SrOnly - capture a seeded 404 tile ## Expected impact A candidate that did not load is visibly not judged as a picture. Could break: lazy images in the windowed mosaic re-rendering on error. ## Evaluation Claim: quality - a failed picture is a drawn state Before: 0 of 13 Plate call sites draw a load failure (grep onError in desk, cull, pair: 0) After: 13 of 13 through the one component (predicted) Method: simulation - the markup is gate-testable, but the shape must be photographed (CLAUDE.md: a deleted or added state must leave a shape) and no capture is allowed this round Result: better Gate: none
evidence: packages/ui/src/components/desk/Plate.tsx:9; grep -rn '<Plate\b' -> 13 sites in 7 files; grep -rn onError packages/ui/src/components/{cull,pair,desk} -> 0
instrument: vitest render of Plate's failed state + cx-capture of a board packet with one seeded 404 candidate

title: A commit in flight draws nothing: the busy state is only aria-busy
body:
## Summary
CommitButton marks a commit in flight only with aria-busy; Desk.module.css has no rule for it, so a sighted operator sees no change until the round trip ends.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/desk/Desk.tsx CommitButton sets aria-busy={busy || undefined}; packages/ui/src/components/desk/Desk.module.css has no [aria-busy] rule (the only one in packages/ui is audio/Rubric.module.css:16). CullFoot and BlindPair pass busy. The press still fires while busy (the callers' latch decides). Fixed: a drawn busy look (cursor progress and a dimmed ground that still holds 4.5:1) on .commit[aria-busy=true].

## Flow
- press commit on a decided packet -> nothing changes until the consequence or the next packet
- fix: one CSS rule; capture commit busy on /kit BoardKit

## Expected impact
The operator stops pressing twice. Could break: the legibility floor if dimmed too far.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the busy state is visible
Before: 0 CSS rules draw .commit busy
After: 1 (predicted)
Method: simulation - a visual state; must be photographed and measured by the legibility lane, neither allowed this round
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: packages/ui/src/components/desk/Desk.tsx aria-busy={busy || undefined}; grep aria-busy packages/ui/src/components/*/*.module.css -> audio/Rubric.module.css only
instrument: cx-capture kit-board with a busy CommitButton specimen + tests/live/legibility.live.spec.ts contrast on it
